name: Sparking Back To School Santiago 2024

information:
Español
En esta oportunidad les traemos un mini campeonato al interior de un gran evento, ¡Feria Sparking Back To School!
Se informa a los competidores que este campeonato se realizará con público observando el evento.

English
This time we bring you a mini championship within a great event, Sparking Back To School!
Competitors are informed that this championship will be held with the public watching the event.
